# Peer review standards

## Objective
Make review a constructive, quality-driven activity that improves the solution and supports team learning.

## Peer review expectations
- Review for clarity, correctness, maintainability, and risk.
- Prefer actionable feedback over personal preference.
- Ask clarifying questions when behavior or intent is unclear.
- Point out design or security concerns early.
- Suggest simpler or more explicit alternatives when appropriate.

## Collaboration norms
- Respect the original intent of the author while improving correctness.
- Keep feedback specific and tied to concrete code or behavior.
- Avoid nitpicking trivial formatting issues without a real quality reason.
- Explain why a suggestion matters for safety, maintainability, or usability.

## Senior standard
Good peer review reduces risk, improves design quality, and helps the team build trustworthy and understandable systems.
